model.name: Qwen Image 2.1 INT8 ConvRot 7B
model.description: Recommended for RTX 4090 24 GB. Official Comfy INT8 ConvRot of Qwen-Image 2.1: unified text-to-image and edit (up to 10 refs, native 2K, RGBA). DiT 7.3 GB + Qwen3-VL-8B INT8 9.4 GB + VAE 0.68 GB. 40 steps, CFG 1. License: Qwen Research License.
model.selector_help: Best default on a 4090. INT8 ConvRot is the ComfyUI template pin: quality stays close to BF16 and the stack fits 24 GB with the encoder offloaded (SGLang measured ~22.7 GiB and ~19 s at 1024). Native 2048 works; drop to 1024 if VRAM spikes with many references. No Lightning/Nunchaku distill exists for 2.1 yet. First download about 18 GB.

resource_requirements.note: 24 GB (4090) is comfortable. 16 GB can run 1024. BF16 needs offload on a 4090.
